definitions.explanation: An artistic technique for creating the illusion of depth and distance on a flat surface.

examples.japanese: {遠近法|えんきんほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠近法|えんきんほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しくない→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧。
examples.english: The perspective in this painting is not correct.

examples.japanese: ルネサンス{期|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遠近法|えんきんほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: Perspective techniques developed greatly during the Renaissance.

notes:
A technique in art for representing three-dimensional space on a flat surface, creating the illusion of depth. The word combines ⟦{遠近|えんきん}→遠近：08124_enkin⟧ (far and near; distance) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method/technique).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠近法|えんきんほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use perspective
- {遠近法|えんきんほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧: perspective technique
- ⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧{透視|とうし}{遠近法|えんきんほう}: one-point perspective
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧{遠近法|えんきんほう}: atmospheric perspective

RELATED WORDS:
- {消失点|しょうしつてん}: vanishing point
- ⟦{構図|こうず}→構図：13178_kouzu⟧: composition (in art)
- ⟦{奥行|おくゆ}き→奥行き：10569_okuyuki⟧: depth; sense of distance
